source.rationale: Delta-4 close, END-TO-END with the producer (company-pick part 3, 2026-08-25). build-cs-member-offer now writes the multi-company close ONCE and exports it as cs_multi_close (bold names in plan order); this arm must render that exact string instead of its own fallback, so the merge turn and the plain member-offer turn ask the customer for the same thing - a COMPANY reply, which the live parser's deterministic company_pick arm (XTODTw @ 8717de6b) resolves against the persisted pool. Same ctx as hand-merge-suggest-plus-member-multicompany apart from the cs_multi_close key; single-company offers export cs_multi_close null and keep the fallback (pinned by hand-merge-single-company-no-labels).
source.repin_rationale: RE-PINNED at live df165492 (media-intake promote). Two changes, both re-derived from the new contract: (1) a final em-dash sanitizer deep-walks the returned payload, so every U+2014 in user_response / variables.* folds to a plain hyphen; (2) miss/DYM lines now carry an entity-type suffix ` (<type>)` on the quoted token - resolver PRIMARY (that token's resolution matches[0].entity_type, prettified only when snake_case/kebab), parser `hint` FALLBACK, bare when neither classifies. The new MI-D media-confirm prefix is inert on these fixtures (patch-transcript not executed). Numbering, dym_last_result_set and dym candidates are unchanged.
